about.title: About
about.heroLine: A first-year PPE student who got tired of spreadsheets
about.story1: Pakamon was born out of real frustration. At the start of my first year in PPE at Tel Aviv University, I tried to figure out how many courses I needed, from which discipline, and what the prerequisites were. The Yedion is an ASP.NET table from the 2000s. The regulations are a 40-page PDF. And there's no tool that connects the two.
about.story2: So I built Pakamon. Not as a final project and not as a startup — just because I needed it. After a few weeks, friends from the program asked for access. Then their friends. Now it's here, open to everyone.
about.whatIs: Pakamon is a degree planning tool for PPE at Tel Aviv University. It helps organize 150 credits across 3 years, track regulation compliance, calculate your graduation score, and build a weekly schedule — without opening the Yedion every time.
about.notList1: Not a commercial product — no subscription, no ads
about.notList2: Not official — not affiliated with the university. Always verify with the secretary's office
about.notList3: Not perfect — there are bugs, there are missing things. If you find something, let me know
about.contact: Questions, bugs, ideas? Write to me:

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions my friends from the program kept asking
faq.a1: No. Pakamon helps plan and track, but it doesn't replace the secretary's office or the academic advisor. Always verify critical decisions (like year transitions or course deferrals) with the official source.
faq.a2: Courses are based on the 2025-26 Yedion. I update manually when things change, but mistakes are possible. If something looks off — check the Yedion and let me know.
faq.q3: Can I take a seminar outside my discipline?
faq.a3: Yes, but there are limits. In Economics you can take a maximum of 2 seminars, and you can't have more than 2 seminars with the same lecturer. Credits count toward the course's discipline, not your focus area.
faq.q4: What happens if I fail a course?
faq.a4: Mark the course as "Failed" in your plan. The credits won't count, the grade won't factor into your average, and you'll need to replan. Pakamon will show you the impact on regulation compliance.
faq.a5: On Supabase servers (AWS in Europe). I can't see your password, I don't share data with anyone, and I don't sell anything. Full details on the Privacy page.
faq.q6: I'm not in PPE. Are there other programs?
faq.a6: Currently Pakamon is built only for PPE at Tel Aviv University. I'm planning to expand to other programs in the future — if you have a program you'd like supported, write to me.
faq.a7: Free. Completely. No subscription, no ads, no "upgrade to pro". I built it because I needed it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Pakamon respects user privacy. Here's exactly what we collect, why, and what we don't do.
privacy.collect1: Email and password (encrypted) — for registration and login
privacy.collect3: Your study plan — courses, grades, semesters
privacy.collect4: Personal preferences — study year, focus area, miluim group
privacy.dontCollect1: No browsing tracking, no third-party cookies
privacy.dontCollect2: No Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel, no trackers
privacy.dontCollect3: We don't sell data to anyone, ever
privacy.storage: Data is stored on Supabase (AWS servers in Europe). Passwords are encrypted. Communication is encrypted via TLS.
privacy.google: If you choose to connect Google Calendar, we only access your calendar for schedule syncing. We don't read existing events, don't access emails, and don't share the data. You can disconnect anytime from Settings.
privacy.delete: Want to delete everything? Write to me and I'll delete all your data within 48 hours.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Pakamon is an unofficial planning tool for PPE students. Use is subject to the following terms.
terms.use1: Use Pakamon to plan your studies
terms.use2: Rely on the information as a starting point, not a substitute for official advising
terms.dont1: Don't try to hack or access other users' data
terms.dont2: Don't use Pakamon data as an official source with the university
terms.dont3: Don't create fake accounts or send spam
terms.disclaimer: Pakamon is not an official tool of Tel Aviv University. Data is based on the Yedion and may change. Always verify with the secretary's office before making critical decisions. I'm not responsible for planning errors based solely on Pakamon.
terms.changes: These terms may be updated. Significant changes will be posted on the site.
